name: Rajiv Gandhi University School of Science and Technology

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a compact, globally‑oriented university in an English‑speaking South American country? Rajiv Gandhi University of Science and Technology (RGUST) offers courses in medicine, sciences, humanities, and technology, plus in‑house training with hands‑on clinical rotations. It is also accredited by Guyana’s National Accreditation Council.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At RGUST, you’ll have an orientation programme designed to help you settle in, meet fellow students and faculty in a supportive setting. Their Student Government Association (SGA) represents student interests and fosters friendly connections across the campus. As a student at RGUST, you can participate in the International Federation of Medical Students (IFMSA), connecting with peers worldwide and engaging in a range of global health initiatives.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
RGUST offers air-conditioned dorms, either single rooms or shared two-bedroom apartments.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Laboratory
At RGUST, you can find modern labs for medical and science programmes.
